title: Human-in-the-Loop Requirements for Financial AI Systems
keywords: AI governance human review threshold financial approval audit compliance invoice
snippet: Most large enterprises retain human approval gates for automated financial decisions above GBP 5,000-10,000.
content: Survey evidence indicates that the majority of large enterprises retain human approval gates for automated financial decisions above a value threshold, most commonly set between GBP 5,000 and GBP 10,000. Audit log retention requirements of seven years are standard for ledger-affecting automated decisions. Ongoing model bias and error review typically adds between GBP 25,000 and GBP 40,000 per deployed model per year, a cost frequently absent from vendor business cases.
